<?php
function h($n,$m,$file,$line){$GLOBALS['keep']=40;unset($GLOBALS['input']);echo 'H;';return true;}
function make(&$slot){echo 'P:',$slot,';';$slot+=1;return $slot;}
function later(){echo 'T;';return 9;}
function &take(&$value,$tail){$value+=100;echo 'F:',$value,':',$tail,';';return $value;}
$input=4;$keep=&$input;set_error_handler('h',8);
$r=&take(make($input),later());$r+=1;
echo 'R:',$r,':',$keep,':',(int)!isset($input),';';

<?php
function h($n,$m,$file,$line){unset($GLOBALS['input']);echo 'H;';throw $GLOBALS['saved'];}
function make(&$slot){echo 'P:',$slot,';';$slot='made';return $slot;}
function later(){echo 'BAD-T;';return 9;}
function &take(&$value,$tail){echo 'BAD-F;';return $value;}
$saved=new Exception('producer-send');$input='seed';$r='old-target';set_error_handler('h',8);
try{$r=&take(make($input),later());}catch(Exception $e){echo 'C:',(int)($e===$saved),':',(int)!isset($input),':',(int)($r==='old-target'),':',(int)($e->getPrevious()===null),';';}
restore_error_handler();$r='recovered';echo 'E:',$r,';';
